title: August 24, 2026
summary: Workspace-wide auto-complete default: admins can turn auto-complete on once for the whole workspace instead of setting it study by study. Under Settings → Governance → Permissions, the Incentive Automation toggle applies auto-complete to studies created from then on, so any session still marked as Scheduled is completed 24 hours after its booked start time, the thank-you is sent, and the incentive is released — whether or not the session took place. Mark a participant as a no-show before then to cancel their incentive instead. Existing studies and past sessions are untouched, any study can override it, and duplicated studies keep the setting from the study they were copied from. Improvements: auto-complete is now described consistently across workspace settings, study automation, permissions, and the help docs.
body_markdown:
### Auto-complete every new study by default


Auto-complete can now be turned on once for the whole workspace instead of study by study. Under[Settings > Governance > Permissions](https://greatquestion.co/governance/permissions) , the **Incentive Automation** toggle applies auto-complete to studies created from then on.


It applies going forward only: existing studies and past sessions are untouched, and you can still override the setting on any individual study from its **Automation** tab. Duplicated studies keep the setting from the study they were copied from, rather than taking the workspace default.
